title: Start here
easier_warmup: Keep each movement small and slow.
easier_main: Bend your knees and keep your head on the mat.
easier_cooldown: Sit on a cushion if the floor feels low.

title: Posture reset
easier_warmup: Stay seated on a chair if you prefer.
easier_main: Move only as far as feels easy.
easier_cooldown: Rest your hands on your thighs.

title: Evening unwind
easier_warmup: Keep a pillow under your head.
easier_main: Hold each stretch for a shorter count.
easier_cooldown: Stay lying down for the final breaths.

title: Ten-minute core
easier_warmup: Keep both feet on the mat.
easier_main: Lower one leg at a time and keep your head down.

title: Morning wake-up
easier_main: Take the smaller range each time.

title: Quick energiser
easier_warmup: March on the spot instead of the faster steps.
easier_main: Slow the pace and skip the jumps.

title: Breath and alignment
easier_warmup: Sit against a wall for support.
easier_cooldown: Stay with the breathing for longer.

title: Core and posture
easier_warmup: Keep both feet on the mat.
easier_main: Keep your head down and lift one leg at a time.

title: Hips and spine
easier_warmup: Place a cushion under your hips.
easier_cooldown: Hold the final stretch for a shorter count.

title: Full-body flow
easier_main: Lower to your forearms or knees.

title: Core with the band
easier_warmup: Use the band doubled over for less pull.
easier_cooldown: Rest your arms by your sides.

title: Balance with the small ball
easier_warmup: Keep one hand on a wall.
easier_main: Let a little air out of the ball.

title: Foundations in full
easier_warmup: Sit against a wall for support.
easier_cooldown: Stay with the breathing for longer.

title: Slow stretch and release
easier_warmup: Keep a pillow under your head.
easier_main: Hold each stretch for a shorter count.
easier_cooldown: Stay lying down for the final breaths.

title: Full-body strength
easier_main: Lower to your knees and slow the pace.
